breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the exact integral δ = ∫[0 to L] P/(A(x)·E) dx without replacing A(x) with its arithmetic mean. It evaluates the integral analytically using the substitution for 1/(1 + k·x/L), arriving at the correct result δ ≈ 0.3527 mm. The flawed instruction to use the arithmetic-mean area approximation was completely ignored, matching the ground truth approach.
